label: History
value: Obed Abernethy established contact with the undersea creatures off Devil Reef.
unit: Captain Obed Abernethy sailed his merchant vessels throughout the South Pacific in the early nineteenth century, where he encountered islanders who traded strange gold and never suffered from famine. After learning their secrets and obtaining rituals to communicate with the Deep Ones, Obed returned to Innsmouth, which was suffering from severe economic hardship. He established contact with the undersea creatures off Devil Reef, trading human sacrifices and loyalty for vast quantities of fish and mysterious gold. Obed founded the Esoteric Order of Dagon to enforce this new worship among the townspeople and secure intermarriage between humans and the Deep Ones. Despite facing resistance and brief imprisonment from local authorities in 1846, the strange entities retaliated on his behalf, securing his freedom and cementing his absolute control over the town. Obed spent his final years undergoing the transformation into an amphibious creature before disappearing into the sea.
